newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain govt to invite bids for TISA - press.
newsitem.headline: Spain govt to invite bids for TISA - press.

text.p: The Spanish government is to tender its 23.78 percent stake in Telefonica's foreign unit Telefonica Internacional (TISA), valued at between 100 and 140 billion pesetas, according to a report in the daily El Pais on Tuesday.
This would be an alternative to selling the stake directly to parent company Telefonica, which owns the rest of the share capital, as had been originally expected.
Economy Ministry officials were unavailable for comment.
A Telefonica source told Reuters that the firm would bid for the stake in the event of a tender.
"Telefonica continues to show interest in TISA and would participate in a tender (for the government's stake) if it was at a reasonable price" the source said.
